task_specification.objective: Make the release candidate closure-ready by restoring the complete Warden silhouette through an explicit presentation binding, qualifying the preserved cemetery package without destructive edits, and hardening the natural seven-to-ten-minute five-wave run through truthful victory, failure, build, result, and replay behavior.

diagnosis.root_cause: Release convergence is blocked by three independent causes. The repeatedly treated camera defect is not follow-transform drift: the generic descendant-to-private-layer compositor activates correctly but preserves only emissive accessories, proving that the complete authored Warden presentation is not bound to the isolation path. The intact accepted cemetery package renders coherently, yet its source geometry retains 69 error-severity zero-area UV surfaces; this requires a non-destructive import/material qualification or explicit package-level incompatibility disposition, never raw-source surgery. Finally, the configured five-wave route and result surfaces exist, but the candidate has not made an uninterrupted ordinary 420–600 second victory, natural build diversity, terminal statistics, and clean replay jointly qualification-ready.

stop_conditions: Do not edit the raw low_poly_graveyard.glb, extract or reposition authored children, duplicate the environment, replace native streets with proxies, or replace the preserved cemetery package.

Do not repeat camera transform, FOV, probe-height, or overscan tuning as the primary repair; stop and report the exact binding limitation if an explicit whole-Warden presentation path cannot render the body.
Do not count diagnostic wave jumps, prepared builds, prepared results, time scaling, or editor-only setup actions as evidence of an ordinary complete run.
Do not modify the deferred Warden semantic-animation issue in this iteration or substitute unrelated animation clips.
Preserve the accepted physical input router, authored title/draft/pause/result hierarchy, three weapon strategies, and separated final-profile prepare, advance, and reset lifecycle fixtures.
Stop the affected task if it introduces boot/parser errors, stale actors or audio after Retry, contradictory terminal commits, or a visible regression in the preserved cemetery composition.

strategy.rationale: Change strategy after three stagnant rounds: replace generic camera descendant isolation with an explicit whole-presentation binding, treat the UV finding through immutable-source qualification rather than mesh surgery, and repair the actual natural route instead of adding another diagnostic shortcut or relying on recapture alone.

code: Run the native project and host boot checks; require no fatal Godot, GDScript, resource-load, or recurring runtime errors.
Inspect the camera binding receipt to prove the authored body and lantern are explicit members and all original visibility layers restore after guard release.
Validate the cemetery qualification and provenance records against the unchanged GLB checksum and intact single runtime binding; reject suppression-only or raw-source changes.
Inspect route invariants for five ordered wave IDs, zero diagnostic jumps on ordinary play, one terminal commit, truthful draft transactions, and next-frame lifecycle isolation.
runtime: Tester repeats the clean physical W-then-Space mausoleum route and binds camera, Warden, dash, occlusion, and layer state at anticipation, active, endpoint, and release frames.
Tester reruns runtime-visible mesh validation on the intact cemetery and captures normal plus dense spawn/landmark views; formal compatibility and issue disposition remain Tester-owned.
Host/Tester plays one uninterrupted 420–600 second ordinary victory, exercises natural drafts and Bellkeeper defeat, inspects the result, then retries and verifies next-frame isolation.
Host/Tester exercises ordinary failure, result Retry, Return to Title, Credits & Notices, pause/resume, and gamepad-equivalent navigation without stale state or duplicate actions.
visual: Compare the same mausoleum framing before and after repair; require the entire Warden body, lantern, nearby threats, and one recoverable lane in every dash-state frame.
Compare spawn, keeper post, mausoleum, cracked bell, and dense-combat cemetery views with the frozen reference while preserving the accepted intact composition.
Capture victory and failure result pages for representative Lantern-, Gravespade-, and Wisp-led builds, with readable statistics, weapon cards, selected upgrades, and focus hierarchy.
Patrol title, gameplay HUD, draft, pause, credits, result, and post-Retry gameplay for preserved Montserrat/icon styling, full-viewport composition, and absence of placeholders or debug presentation.

done_when: The camera binds an explicit, auditable set representing the complete Warden presentation, including the authored body and lantern, without changing accepted model transforms or authored cemetery children.

The ordinary physical W-then-Space route shows the complete Warden silhouette during dash anticipation, active movement, recovery, and the mausoleum endpoint while nearby threats and at least one escape lane remain readable.

Occlusion activation and release remain sightline-driven, the ordinary camera retains its high-angle framing, and telemetry reports the explicit binding members, blocked samples, compositor state, and clean release.
Pause, resume, non-occluded traversal, collision sliding, dash cooldown, and invulnerability ownership remain unchanged and free of duplicate presentation layers.
tasks.instructions: Replace the failed generic descendant-layer assumption with an explicit camera-owned binding to the complete Warden presentation boundary. Audit PresentationRoot, its authored body, lantern, and shipped visibility effects; restore or wrap the direct instances needed by the isolation compositor so the skinned body is rendered alongside emissive accessories. This is a binding repair, not another transform/FOV/probe-tuning pass. Keep the authored cemetery untouched, preserve accepted Warden transforms and gameplay camera behavior, expose binding membership and completeness in camera state, and guarantee deterministic activation and clean layer restoration after sightline clearance.
tasks.title: Bind the complete Warden to camera isolation

done_when: The raw cemetery GLB checksum, single intact runtime instance, authored hierarchy, package transform, outer datum, landmarks, streets, and native composition remain unchanged.

A candidate-owned qualification record contains the actual retest mesh/surface counts, affected material and tangent-space dependencies, renderer observations, source checksum, runtime binding, and explicit compatibility conclusion.

Either a receipt-safe, non-destructive import or material compatibility correction produces zero error-severity degenerate-UV findings on runtime-visible surfaces, or the record explicitly concludes package-level incompatibility for Tester disposition; warning suppression alone does not pass.
Spawn, mausoleum, keeper-post, cracked-bell, and representative dense-combat views retain grounded geometry, coherent scale and materials, clear routes, and no matte or edge-color contamination.
tasks.instructions: Qualify the preserved intact cemetery as an immutable whole-authored-environment singleton. First audit whether any receipt-safe importer or runtime material compatibility setting can eliminate the tangent-space risk without rewriting geometry, extracting children, changing the authored hierarchy, or hiding validator output. If not, create an explicit package-level incompatibility record with matched material, renderer, checksum, and validator evidence for Tester disposition while retaining the current package. Update provenance to bind that record. Asset-family contract if recompilation occurs: family_id cemetery_authored_environment; PRD style match moonlit stylized cemetery; source quality whole-authored-environment; one intact runtime use covering the arena; one distinct/runtime variant; maximum share 1.0; native streets, structures, props, materials, and landmarks are internal diversity; opaque terrain background; evidence views are spawn, three landmarks, and dense combat.

done_when: An uninterrupted ordinary run started from Play records exactly the five expected wave IDs in order, zero diagnostic jumps, a Bellkeeper transition, and a single authoritative victory between 420 and 600 seconds.

Natural draft choices—not prepared builds—can produce Lantern-focused, Gravespade-led, and Wandering-Wisps-led viable build histories, with each accepted card matching its advertised before-to-after transaction.
Victory and failure results truthfully show elapsed time, level, defeated enemies, damage dealt, damage taken, weapon ranks, and selected upgrades, with exactly one terminal commit per run.

Retry and Return to Title retire enemies, boss, projectiles, pickups, effects, attack ledgers, audio voices, pause ownership, and stale UI before the next frame, while Credits & Notices and repository-relative provenance remain reachable.
tasks.instructions: Audit and repair the actual ordinary-route state machine, pacing, draft eligibility, boss transition, terminal snapshot, and replay lifecycle so the required seven-to-ten-minute run is inherently completable without editor preparation. Preserve the data-driven five-wave structure and existing three weapon strategies. Add only candidate-owned observability needed to distinguish natural wave history, build history, terminal commit count, and reset isolation; it must not advance gameplay or make diagnostic routes ordinary-eligible. Tune route data or transition guards only where source inspection shows the natural path cannot satisfy the contract, and keep failure and victory result summaries truthful.
